business_problem: KPMG needed a better way to support enterprise data federation, governance, and analytics modernization because legacy Hadoop infrastructure and firmwide data silos made it difficult to serve analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases with the speed clients expected.
solution_summary: KPMG uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support enterprise data federation, governance, and analytics modernization. The implementation replaced a legacy state where legacy Hadoop infrastructure and firmwide data silos made it difficult to serve analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases with the speed clients expected. On-premises sql data and cloud warehouse data move through Spark Declarative Pipelines and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog and Delta Sharing governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. Databricks SQL, MLflow, and Agent Bricks operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver federated governed datasets and Power BI dashboards. KPMG improved enterprise data federation, governance, and analytics modernization with measurable results including faster delivery from raw data to production decisions, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
business_outcome: KPMG improved enterprise data federation, governance, and analytics modernization with measurable results including faster delivery from raw data to production decisions, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
architecture_clues: Centralized governance, lineage, and access controls are enforced through Unity Catalog.
Delta Lake provides the shared storage layer for curated lakehouse datasets.
Automated ingestion and transformation pipelines keep source data synchronized for downstream analytics and AI.
Operational AI workflows are deployed directly beside governed data and analytics assets.
evidence_quotes: We truly use Databricks as the foundation for everything we do,
For the first time, we’ve created a true enterprise platform that can support the dynamic needs of both our front- and back-office professionals at KPMG.
